title: CT Contrast Safety: Kidney Risk and Prior Reactions
subject: Radiology
preview: Contrast-related kidney risk depends on baseline kidney function, acute kidney injury, volume status and the specific imaging context.
quickRevision: Contrast-related kidney risk depends on baseline kidney function, acute kidney injury, volume status and the specific imaging context.
Modern iodinated contrast decisions should balance diagnostic benefit with individual risk; avoid reflexive withholding in emergencies.
Consider alternatives, hydration when indicated and appropriate documentation under radiology policy.

sections.title: Clinical syndrome and red flags
points: Contrast-related kidney risk depends on baseline kidney function, acute kidney injury, volume status and the specific imaging context.
Prior allergic-like contrast reactions require a separate risk assessment from kidney-related concerns.

sections.title: Differentiate and manage
points: Modern iodinated contrast decisions should balance diagnostic benefit with individual risk; avoid reflexive withholding in emergencies.
Consider alternatives, hydration when indicated and appropriate documentation under radiology policy.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Contrast allergy and contrast-associated kidney injury are different safety issues.

quiz.question: Which history most directly predicts risk of another allergic-like contrast reaction?
options: A prior allergic-like reaction to iodinated contrast
quiz.explanation: A prior allergic-like reaction to iodinated contrast. Prior allergic-like contrast reactions require a separate risk assessment from kidney-related concerns.
